# AsthmaWatch synthetic dataset — data dictionary
**All data is synthetic/simulated** (`data_source = "synthetic"`). Not clinical data. Generated by `generate_synthetic_data.py` (seed 42).

**Size:** 60 patients × 14 sessions × 60 one-minute windows = 50,400 rows. Class mix ≈ 58% LOW / 27% MEDIUM / 15% HIGH.
**Split:** by patient (`split` = train/val/test, 70/15/15) so no child appears in two splits.

## Keys / metadata
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| patient_id, session_id, window_idx, timestamp | Child, 1-hour session, minute index 0–59, time |
| split | train / val / test (patient-level) |
| scenario | normal_rest, normal_activity, increased_activity, mild_symptoms, trigger_exposure, exercise_induced, high_risk_episode, recovery |
| env_type | indoor_ac, indoor_home, outdoor_day, outdoor_monsoon, cooking_smoke, dust_or_incense |

## Wristband features
| Column | Sensor | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| hr_bpm | MAX30102 | Rises with activity AND severity (confounded) |
| spo2_pct | MAX30102 | Falls with severity; noisy under motion |
| resp_rate_ppg | MAX30102 (PPG-derived) | breaths/min |
| ppg_perfusion_index, hrv_rmssd_ms, ppg_signal_quality | MAX30102 | Quality drops with movement |
| temp_c, humidity_pct, gas_resistance_kohm | BME680 | Low gas resistance = more VOC. No pressure used. |

## Pendant features
| Column | Sensor | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| wheeze_index, wheeze_band_ratio, dominant_freq_hz, spectral_centroid_hz, spectral_flatness | INMP441 | Wheeze features; less reliable in loud environments |
| cough_count, ambient_noise_db, audio_quality | INMP441 | |
| accel_mean_g, accel_std_g, step_count, trunk_tilt_deg, activity_level, posture | MPU6050 | Forward-leaning sitting posture appears in distress |

## Labels and evaluation-only columns (do NOT use as model inputs)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| risk_label / risk_label_id | LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH (0/1/2), from hidden latent severity |
| risk_next_15min | Label 15 min ahead within session (forecasting target; NaN at end) |
| rule_based_risk | Naive absolute-threshold rules (baseline to beat) |
| latent_severity, latent_activity, env_risk_index | Hidden generator state |
| ref_driver_* , ref_n_drivers | Reference "ground-truth" explanation flags: spo2_drop, hr_above_expected, wheeze, resp_rate, low_activity_context, env_trigger, cough. Use to score whether SHAP/LIME explanations name the right evidence |
| motion_artifact_flag | Window affected by a motion artefact |

## Realism built in
- Per-child baselines (age-dependent HR/RR, SpO₂, wheeze and trigger sensitivity) in `asthmawatch_synthetic_patients.csv`
- Healthy exertion (high HR/RR, normal SpO₂, no wheeze) vs. dangerous low-activity high-HR cases
- Exercise-induced episodes: symptoms appear *after* activity stops
- Environmental triggers act with a lag; night-time worsening; rare "silent chest" (severe but little wheeze)
- ~1% missing values, wristband/pendant dropout bursts, motion artefacts
